priority.note: Bulking has taken a back seat. Showing up three times a week is the goal being measured right now. Calorie surplus is secondary and intake is untracked by design. Weekly reviews lead with adherence, not with weight.

nutrition_logging.reason: Daily photo logging was more friction than it was worth. The goal is to eat more, which does not require tracking to execute.
nutrition_logging.note: Logged data to date ran slightly above his normal diet, so ~2500 is the honest baseline. Protein is handled by habit and is not tracked. The dashboard and logging pipeline are untouched and work the moment he sends a photo again. Nothing about target-setting breaks: targets were always set by the 7-day weight trend, never by logged intake.

targets.note: Provisional. Derived from Mifflin-St Jeor at 170 lb / 74 in with a 1.6 activity multiplier, plus a ~250 kcal surplus. With intake logging paused these function as a directional reference, not something to hit precisely. The weekly review reads the weight trend and gives a direction, eat more or hold, rather than a number to count to. First real weight readings landed 2026-09-13, so calibration moved out to allow two weeks of trend.

training.condition: a logged session on a scheduled lift day
training.note: Counts consecutive scheduled lift days with a logged session. Missing one resets. Optional add-ins and Saturday flex work neither break it nor count toward it, so an extra session is always free. Counting by week was rejected: a week-based streak breaks on one missed Friday and then reads as total failure, which is the opposite of useful.

nutrition.note: Dormant while nutrition logging is paused, deliberately not deleted. Calories are not a condition because photo estimates are too noisy to gate a streak on. Resumes working the moment a food photo arrives.

review_cadence.weekly: Sunday, automated. Reads the week, writes next week's program and data/reviews/weekly-YYYY-MM-DD.md, then messages a summary. Leads with adherence.
review_cadence.monthly: 2nd of the month, automated. Progress summary emailed via Resend and written to data/reviews/monthly-YYYY-MM.md. InBody scans arrive as photos he uploads in chat.
